title: Mick's 2017 Metabunk post calls the Dietrich account laughable

plain: In December 2017, the skeptic Mick West is said to have dismissed as laughable a Navy pilot's account of a UFO encounter, in a post on Metabunk, his online forum for checking strange claims. The researcher Marik von Rennenkampff puts it to West directly on the show. He reads out West's December 30 post from a forum thread about FLIR1, an infrared Navy video of an unexplained object, written in reply to an interview with Commander Alex Dietrich, a Navy pilot. To the Stars Academy, a private company that studied UFOs, had released that interview. Von Rennenkampff raises it to suggest West brushed off a credible witness too quickly.
